acceptance_criteria.details: Used better-t-stack CLI scaffold with turborepo addon
turbo build passes for all workspaces

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC3: Dev server starts without errors
acceptance_criteria.details: bun run dev starts both server and web apps

discoveries.discovery: CLI scaffolds save significant time for initial project setup
discoveries.context: Used 'bun create better-t-stack@latest' with flags for database, auth, frontend, backend
discoveries.lesson: For new projects, always check if a maintained CLI scaffold exists for the tech stack
discoveries.benefit: 45 minutes vs estimated 4+ hours manual setup

discoveries.discovery: TanStack Router requires route tree generation before TypeScript passes
discoveries.context: TypeScript check failed with 'Cannot find module ./routeTree.gen'
discoveries.lesson: Run 'vite build' once to generate routeTree.gen.ts before running type checks

what_worked: CLI scaffold generated complete working monorepo structure
Turborepo caches build artifacts for fast rebuilds
Workspace catalog in package.json centralizes dependency versions
better-auth integration worked out of the box
what_could_improve: Document the scaffold flags used for reproducibility

recommendations.recommendation: Always use scaffold CLIs for new projects
recommendations.rationale: Scaffolds encode best practices and save hours of boilerplate
recommendations.action: Check for maintained scaffolds before manual setup
